title: Bloom Puff-Sleeve Fishtail Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Bloom Puff-Sleeve Fishtail Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Fitted off-shoulder maternity photoshoot gown with ruffled bloom puff sleeves and a cascading ruffle fishtail skirt. US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a fitted white gown that shows off the bump, with big ruffled bloom sleeves, an off-the-shoulder sweetheart neckline and a fishtail skirt of cascading cream ruffles that opens to a high slit and a sweeping train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
sweetheart neckline worn off the shoulders, short puffed sleeves with large ruffled blooms, a fitted body, and a fishtail skirt with cascading ruffle tiers, a high front slit and a train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust and hips today, and size up if you want extra room over the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a fitted white maternity gown with an off-the-shoulder sweetheart neckline, short puffed sleeves finished with large ruffled cream organza blooms, a smooth body shaped over the bump and hips, and a fishtail skirt with a high front slit edged by cascading tiers of large ruffled cream organza, ending in a long train
